title_en: 2+1 APARTMENT FOR SALE - NEAR THE BOTANICAL GARDEN
description_en: In one of the quietest and preferred residential areas, above the Botanical Garden of Tirana and near the Selita Mosque, a 2+1 apartment with a very functional organization is offered for sale. Area: 115 m² gross 102 m² net Organization: spacious living room which includes the kitchen area 2 comfortable bedrooms 1 bathroom Balcony The apartment is located in a new building with an elevator, with contemporary construction standards and regular administration. The area is characterized by calm, clean air and greenery, offering a comfortable and quality lifestyle, away from noise but with easy access to the city center. Ideal for family residence or long-term investment. For more information or to visit the property, get in touch!
